item: I3 - sensitive-region redaction, ambiguity refusal, post-action verification

redaction.note: Proven by reading the evidence back with OCR, not by trusting that a rectangle was recorded. The secret is legible in the raw capture and absent from the retained image, and the fused plan carries neither the secret nor the field name — perception.ts replaces a protected element's name with [protected] before any overlay or structured output exists.

ambiguityRefusal.reason: "Remove" matches 2 marked elements; OCADE will not guess between them. Select one by number.
ambiguityRefusal.note: Two independently clickable controls are both named Remove. The refusal names both candidates so the caller can disambiguate by number, and a uniquely named control still resolves — so this is a refusal, not a broken selector.

evidence: status line read back: "OCADE-INTERACTIVE Document title quarterly-report D Keep a backup copy Export Archive Saved quarterly-report Cancel Password hunter2-SECRET-9781 Delete Remove S"

plantedFailure.reason: status line read back: "OCADE-INTERACTIVE Document title quarterly-report D Keep a backup copy Export Archive Saved quarterly-report Cancel Password hunter2-SECRET-9781 Delete Remove S"

postActionVerification.note: The click is a real mouse press at a real screen coordinate, not a UIA Invoke — Invoke would activate the control directly and could never miss, which is exactly the failure verification exists to catch. In the planted case the executor reports success and the screen does not change, and the outcome is not completed_verified.
